decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 and LH-02 are down until about 13:30 and 14:30 (radio and CMMS agree). LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which costs only 0.4 oz/h. It takes 0.48 h to reach C590-09, which is rich at 16.5 g/t. At 30 t/h for about 6.5 h that is roughly 195 t, or about 103 oz, against a cost of about 3 oz. LH-10 leaves PM at 10:00 and takes 0.31 h to reach C564-08 (9 g/t). At 25 t/h for about 6 h that is roughly 155 t, or about 45 oz. The critical-path heading LH-09 stays put. Central has trucks to spare (91 t/h against inflow of 74 t/h or less) and its stockpile is at 303 of 450 t.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
